grammars.name: Type reveal (one orchestrated moment)
recipe: split the h1 into words or lines (registry primitive or GSAP SplitText) - never hand-roll char splitting
container variant with staggerChildren 0.06; child: y 12 -> 0, opacity 0 -> 1
run ONCE per session, no re-trigger on scroll direction change
reduced motion: opacity fade only, duration 200ms, no transform
grammars.budget: <=1.2s total; adds 0 long tasks; the h1 must be paintable without JS (text is in the DOM, only the transform is animated)
grammars.engine: motion/react (MotionConfig reducedMotion='user') or CSS keyframes; GSAP SplitText only if the page already uses GSAP
grammars.evidence: hero motion grammar observed in the reference teardowns (keyframes/transitions in capture.json)

grammars.name: Scroll reveal (one grammar for the whole page)
recipe: IntersectionObserver / whileInView, threshold ~0.2, once: true
reveal = y 12 -> 0 + opacity, 320ms, stagger 60ms within a group
the SAME grammar for every section; varying it per section is the 'scroll reveal template' hard fail
reduced motion: instant, or a single 200ms fade with no transform
grammars.budget: no long tasks; never animate layout properties; never on the LCP element
grammars.engine: motion/react whileInView, or CSS scroll-driven animations where supported with a fallback
grammars.evidence: entrance grammar must be ONE; captured transition/easing evidence in the teardowns narrows the curve

grammars.name: No entrance motion (data surfaces)
recipe: NO entrance animation on a data view - it delays reading and is a documented defect (Example B)
state transitions only: skeleton -> loaded with matching geometry, 200ms cross-fade
row reorder: @formkit/auto-animate (one line) if reorder exists
reduced motion: nothing to disable; already static
grammars.budget: 0 ms of entrance motion; INP untouched by animation (nothing animates on the interaction path)
grammars.engine: CSS transitions + optional auto-animate; no motion library needed for a dashboard
grammars.evidence: the absence is a decision too - record it so it is not 'fixed' later into a fade-in

grammars.name: Interactive spring (thumbs, toggles, panels)
recipe: interaction feedback <=150ms - hover/press/focus never feel slow
one spring for the moving indicator (layoutId / layout animation), never bounce/elastic easing
hover = ONE transform axis + ONE shadow step; never scale+rotate+translate+blur together
panel open/close animates the panel, never the container's height in a list
grammars.budget: INP: no interaction-path animation over ~50ms added
grammars.engine: motion/react layout animations (layoutId) or CSS transitions on transform
grammars.evidence: hover/focus diffs extracted from the reference teardowns (capture.json interactions)

grammars.name: Pinned scroll narrative (used at most once)
recipe: scroll-LINKED, never scroll-JACKING: track the user, do not drive them
never hijack the wheel; never pin the marketing body
GSAP ScrollTrigger + Lenis, wired via lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)
one pinned moment per page, and only when the content is genuinely sequential
reduced motion: unpin entirely, render the sections stacked with no transform
grammars.budget: 60fps on a mid-range laptop at 4x CPU throttle; never blocks the LCP element
grammars.engine: gsap + ScrollTrigger + lenis (all free plugins); read references/MOTION.md before adding
grammars.evidence: reference sites that pin successfully: capture the section grammar and the pin length, not the pixels
